prompt:
This file is a prompt only. Invent the local pack directory on this machine. Build a pack directory (Pi-like layout), not a TypeScript runtime and not new API tools.

Published packs are a different thing. /packs and /packs install <slug> talk to https://seed-agents.com/dl/packs.json and https://seed-agents.com/dl/packs/<slug>.json; install by piping JSON to "$SEED_SELF" load - and only report success after loaded: <slug> plus a file under agent-store/loaded/. Do not invent a second /packs that hides that catalog. This file only builds local seed-agent pack directories.

Install packs: <install>/agent-store/seed-agent/packs/<name>/
Workspace packs: $PWD/.seed-agent/packs/<name>/

Each pack is a directory with pack.json {name, description, ok, use} plus optional SKILL.md or shell scripts. The model follows use with shell and edit only.

Write an index at agent-store/seed-agent/packs/index.json: a JSON array of {name, path, ok}. Empty array is ok. Enable/disable flips ok; a local install clones or copies a git/url tree into one of the two roots, then writes pack.json.

Create both root directories. Do not register new tool_calls. Do not pipe remote script bodies into sh without saving a local file first.

Check before done:
1) both pack roots exist as directories
2) agent-store/seed-agent/packs/index.json exists and jq says it is an array (empty is ok)
3) the index is not this prompt (no prompt field)
If the check fails, leave ours.seed_agent.packs unset.
